name: Client to bridge entry
info:
Normalizes raw client entries into the standard bridge entry format. Routes by `msg.metadata.source.client_system`.

### Input
`msg.payload` = single raw entry (Rayvn or WaSOS format), `msg.metadata` = standard metadata

### Rayvn mapping
`{ id, text, timeCreated->timestamp, loggedByFullName->author, files, labels }`

### WaSOS mapping
`{ id, content->text, createdAt->timestamp, username->author, files, labels: [] }`

WaSOS location entries (GeoJSON) are detected and routed through the Generate Map Image subflow. The resulting JPEG map snapshot is attached to `files`.

### Output
`msg.payload = { id, text, timestamp, author, files, labels }`

And for the Generate Map Image subflow, set the info field to:

Generates a JPEG map snapshot with a red marker from geographic coordinates.
Uses OpenStreetMap tiles at zoom level 15, composited into an 800px wide image.

### Input
`msg.geo = { lat, lng }`

### Output
`msg.mapImage = { name, type, buffer }` — JPEG image (~<1MB at quality 80)
